steps.content: [Dark alley]
The girl stands still in the sunlight, her gaze calm, awaiting an answer from you.
Noticing your hesitation, she responds with a polite smile before turning her glance upward to the veiled sky.

steps.speaker: Unknown Girl
steps.content: I liked it here. Seeing everyone here carrying hope in their hearts, all working together toward a common goal.
Her expression is gentle, her voice soft and her demeanor harmless. Yet her gaze directs toward some distant point beyond you.

You turn to look in the direction of her gaze, but see nothing unusual. The townsfolk in the square are still going about their day. Is she speaking to you? Her tone gives no indication, but there's no one else in the dark alley.

options: Did you see the shadows here just now?

steps.content: The girl doesn't answer. Instead, she smiles softly as she caresses the drooping flower stems. At her touch, another datura blossom withers and falls.

steps.speaker: Unknown Girl
steps.content: We all believe Désir is our gateway to DisCity. Miss Vautour Bleu says we're just a step away from the life of our dreams. You believe that too...

steps.speaker: Unknown Girl
steps.content: Don't you?
The sweet floral scent and warm sunlight seem to dissolve, replaced by a thickening miasma of contamination. Your instincts sharpen—this girl is no ordinary local.

steps.speaker: Unknown Girl
steps.content: Have you ever been to DisCity?
The girl seems oblivious to your growing wariness, her tone unchanged, as if lost in a reverie.
Only from what I've seen in the papers... I guess?
Unfazed by your evasive answer, the girl continues, her tone insistent.

steps.speaker: Unknown Girl
steps.content: What it is like in DisCity... Will the medicine be expensive there? Will the doctors there be impatient with me too...?

steps.speaker: Unknown Girl
steps.content: Will they... shun me for my sickness, like everyone back home...?
Her words grow erratic, and her mood seems unstable. Is she seeking treatment in DisCity? You've heard a similar story from the townsfolk.
Are you alright?
Using the shackles would risk exposing your identity, so you approach her as gently as possible. But the girl suddenly recoils, shaking her head frantically as if terrified.

steps.speaker: Unknown Girl
steps.content: No, stay back... My letter hasn't been sent yet. My parents still haven't heard from me...
Her words and mind spiral into chaos. Yet what she's said rings a bell. A name flashes in your mind... a name that shouldn't be here now in Désir.
The illusion before you freezes. As if struck by shock and fear, the girl begins convulsing violently. Dark tendrils of Mania coil around her, ripping away the facade to reveal her true form.
In a blink, the illusion turns into a monstrous figure twisted by manic obsession. The Corruptor lunges at you with terrifying speed.
You react instinctively, but the narrow alley leaves little room to maneuver, and your physical capabilities are definitely no match for the Corruptor's inhuman speed...
Bang!!
Your attempt to dodge fails. In a split second, you're slammed against the wall by crushing force.

The monster's hands clamp down, muffling your mouth and nose. The miasma of Mania invades your lungs, almost smothering you. As suffocation sets in, your head spins, your heartbeat thunders in your ears, and your vision begins to warp...
You see Désir in ruins, overrun by monsters, with noxious contamination seeping into every inch of the town's soil.
Is this... a hallucination before death?
[Filter][Town center][Portraits of surrounding monsters]

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Primrose, what are you looking for?

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Monsters, so many monsters... surrounding... Désir...

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Have you seen him? He was here just a moment ago.
steps.female_content: Have you seen her? She was here just a moment ago.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: DisCity... Vautour Bleu's... lie...

Dark clouds loom over the bustling marketplace, where Corruptors run rampant among the townsfolk. These rotting, contamination-ridden monsters brush shoulders with ordinary people, wandering the streets right before your eyes.
[Dark alley]
...Lie? What turned Sheila into that? Numerous questions flood your mind while the prolonged suffocation drains your strength. Your fading consciousness clings to a single, instinctive thought...
No matter what, can't let Mania harm the innocent townsfolk...
Crimson spikes of light begin forming in your palm. But just then, you hear a faint tapping sound drawing near. Tap, tap, tap...
It's footsteps... in high heels.
What are you waiting for?
You instantly retract the shackles in your hand. Before you can proceed, a mysterious figure appears next to you, a warm breath grazing your ear.
Your mind, clouded by suffocation, snaps to sudden clarity. Before you can turn to look, a soft touch encircles your wrist. Then, a gentle yet firm grip pulls you backward...
[Rescue CG][Change background music]
How have the folks of Désir been treating our guest while I was away?
Dove says your place has a lovely view. We should have tea together on the balcony sometime, if you're up for it.
[Balcony flashback]
You are...
The woman effortlessly resolves the impending threat. Before you can utter her name, the wand in her hand and the formidable power have demonstrated her identity.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Here's a little free tip: as a newcomer, it's best not to wander around alone.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Wouldn't you agree... my new neighbor?
